pages.title: Google Analytics (GA4)
pages.description: Connect CrowdChange to Google Analytics 4 to track pageviews, donation events, and fundraising campaign performance across your site.

pages.title: Google Tag Manager
pages.description: Set up Google Tag Manager on CrowdChange to forward donation, checkout, and pageview events to your marketing and analytics tools.

pages.title: Facebook Pixel
pages.description: Install the Facebook Pixel and Conversions API in CrowdChange to track donations, retarget visitors, and measure ad performance on Meta.

pages.title: Pinterest
pages.description: Add the Pinterest Tag and Conversions API to CrowdChange to track pageviews, add-to-cart, and donation checkout events from Pinterest ads.

pages.title: Reddit
pages.description: Add the Reddit Pixel and Conversions API to CrowdChange to track pageviews, add-to-cart, and donation purchase events from Reddit ads.

pages.title: TikTok
pages.description: Add the TikTok Pixel and Events API to CrowdChange to track pageviews, add-to-cart, and completed donation payment events from TikTok ads.

pages.title: Widgets Overview
pages.description: Embed CrowdChange fundraising widgets on your website with a single script tag, then add donation forms, progress bars, and thermometers anywhere on the page.

pages.title: Donation Form Widget
pages.description: Embed the CrowdChange donation form on your site to accept donations inline or in a popup, with customizable colors, language, and layout.

pages.title: Progress Widget
pages.description: Embed the CrowdChange progress widget to display a live fundraising progress bar for any campaign, team, or personal page, with customizable colors.

pages.title: Thermometer Widget
pages.description: Embed the CrowdChange thermometer widget to display a live fundraising thermometer with goal and raised amounts for any campaign, team, or personal page.

pages.title: Overview
pages.description: Learn how to authenticate with the CrowdChange API, the base URLs, HTTP methods, response codes, date formatting, and error conventions used.

pages.title: Get All
pages.description: Retrieve all CrowdChange transactions within a time window or by payout ID, with full payment processor, donor, and campaign attribution details.

pages.title: Find Campaign
pages.description: Search CrowdChange campaigns server-side with rich filters and retrieve a paginated list of matching fundraisers with goal, raised, and status data.

pages.title: Find Team
pages.description: Search CrowdChange fundraising teams server-side with rich filters and retrieve a paginated list with captain, goal, and raised totals for each.

pages.title: Find Personal Page
pages.description: Search CrowdChange personal fundraising pages server-side with rich filters and retrieve a paginated list with goal, raised, and owner details.

pages.title: Get Campaign
pages.description: Retrieve detailed server-side information about a CrowdChange campaign by its fundraiser ID, including configuration, goal, raised, and donor stats.

pages.title: Get Campaign Teams
pages.description: Search teams registered under a CrowdChange campaign by keyword and retrieve a paginated list with captain, goal, and raised totals for each.

pages.title: Create Offline Transaction
pages.description: Record an offline donation transaction against a CrowdChange campaign on behalf of a donor, including amount, payment method, and donor details.

pages.title: Get offline transactions
pages.description: Retrieve a paginated list of offline donation transactions recorded against a CrowdChange campaign, including amount, donor, and entry metadata.

pages.title: Sign In
pages.description: Authenticate a CrowdChange user and receive an auth token for user-specific API calls, including the two-factor authentication challenge flow.

pages.title: Sign Out
pages.description: Invalidate the current CrowdChange auth token to sign the authenticated user out of the active session on a single device or client.

pages.title: Sign Out All Devices
pages.description: Invalidate every active auth token for the authenticated CrowdChange user, signing them out of all devices and sessions in a single call.

pages.title: Upload Image
pages.description: Upload an image file to CrowdChange on behalf of the authenticated user, returning a hosted URL you can attach to personal pages or teams.

pages.title: Get Campaigns
pages.description: Retrieve a paginated list of CrowdChange campaigns where the authenticated user is registered, including role, goal, and amount raised per campaign.

pages.title: Get Personal Pages
pages.description: Retrieve a paginated list of the authenticated user's personal fundraising pages across all CrowdChange campaigns, with goals and raised amounts.

pages.title: Get Teams
pages.description: Retrieve a paginated list of CrowdChange fundraising teams the authenticated user belongs to, including role, campaign, goal, and raised totals.

pages.title: Get Team's Personal Pages
pages.description: Retrieve a paginated list of personal fundraising pages registered under the authenticated user's team within a CrowdChange campaign.

pages.title: Update Personal Page
pages.description: Update the authenticated user's personal fundraising page within a CrowdChange campaign, including title, story, goal, and cover image.

pages.title: Update Team
pages.description: Update the authenticated user's CrowdChange fundraising team within a campaign, including name, description, goal, and team cover image.

pages.title: Page Donors List
pages.description: Retrieve a paginated list of donors for the authenticated user's personal page within a campaign, returning 10 donors per page with amount details.

pages.title: Create Offline Transaction
pages.description: Record an offline donation transaction on behalf of the authenticated user against a CrowdChange campaign, with amount and donor details.

pages.title: Team Donors List
pages.description: Retrieve a paginated list of donors for the authenticated user's team within a campaign, returning 10 donors per page with names and amounts.

pages.title: Subscribe Webhook
pages.description: Register a new CrowdChange webhook subscription pointing at your target URL to start receiving event payloads from the fundraising platform.

pages.title: Unsubscribe webhook
pages.description: Remove an existing CrowdChange webhook subscription so the target URL stops receiving event payloads from the fundraising platform.

pages.title: Get webhooks
pages.description: Retrieve a paginated list of every CrowdChange webhook subscription registered on your account, with target URL, subscribed events, and status.

pages.title: Subscribe Webhook events
pages.description: Add specific CrowdChange system events to an existing webhook subscription so the target URL starts receiving those event payloads.

pages.title: Unsubscribe Webhook events
pages.description: Remove specific CrowdChange system events from an existing webhook subscription so the target URL stops receiving those event payloads.

pages.title: Get logs
pages.description: Retrieve a paginated log of webhook delivery attempts for a CrowdChange webhook subscription, including event type, status, and response details.

pages.title: Resend logged event
pages.description: Resend a previously logged CrowdChange webhook event to its subscriber URL, useful for retrying failed deliveries or debugging webhook handlers.

pages.title: Resend event by payload hash
pages.description: Resend the newest logged CrowdChange webhook delivery that matches a payload hash, creating a new delivery attempt with the same payload.

pages.title: Send event
pages.description: Trigger a CrowdChange webhook to fire an event payload based on an existing entity, useful for testing endpoints and replaying historical data.

pages.title: Event payloads
pages.description: Reference the JSON payloads sent by CrowdChange webhook events.

pages.title: Goal / Raised Amounts
pages.description: Retrieve the goal amount, raised amount, donor count, and core campaign metadata for a specific CrowdChange campaign by its fundraiser ID.

pages.title: Donors List
pages.description: Retrieve a paginated list of donors for a specific CrowdChange campaign, returning 10 donor records per page with name, amount, and donation date.

pages.title: Heatmap
pages.description: Retrieve aggregated donation counts and amounts raised by country and state for a CrowdChange campaign, suitable for rendering a geographic heatmap.

pages.title: Team Donors List
pages.description: Retrieve a paginated list of donors for a specific team within a CrowdChange campaign, returning 10 donors per page with names and donation amounts.

pages.title: Page Donors List
pages.description: Retrieve a paginated list of donors for a personal fundraising page within a CrowdChange campaign, returning 10 donors per page with amount details.

pages.title: Find Campaign
pages.description: Search CrowdChange campaigns by keyword and retrieve a paginated list of matching fundraisers with goal, raised, and status data for each.

pages.title: Find Team
pages.description: Search CrowdChange fundraising teams by keyword and retrieve a paginated list of matching teams with goal, raised amount, and campaign details.

pages.title: Get Team
pages.description: Retrieve a single CrowdChange fundraising team by ID, including parent campaign, captain, member count, goal, and total raised so far.

pages.title: Find Personal Page
pages.description: Search public CrowdChange personal fundraising pages by keyword and retrieve a paginated list of matches with goal, raised, and owner details.

pages.title: Get Personal Page
pages.description: Retrieve a single CrowdChange personal fundraising page by ID, including owner, parent campaign, goal, raised amount, and recent donor activity.

pages.title: Activities Leaderboard
pages.description: Retrieve the activity tracker leaderboard of personal pages, returning 10 participants per page ranked by tracked steps, distance, or minutes.

pages.title: Activities Teams Leaderboard
pages.description: Retrieve the activity tracker teams leaderboard with up to 10 teams per page, ranked by tracked steps, distance, or activity minutes raised.

pages.title: Activities Campaigns Leaderboard
pages.description: Retrieve the activity tracker campaigns leaderboard with up to 10 fundraisers per page, ranked by tracked steps, distance, or activity minutes.

pages.title: Site wide stats
pages.description: Retrieve site-wide aggregated stats across all CrowdChange campaigns, including total raised, donor count, and number of active fundraisers.

pages.title: Top Daily Campaigns
pages.description: Retrieve the daily ranking of top CrowdChange campaigns by amount raised over the last 24 hours, ideal for a leaderboard or homepage widget.

pages.title: Top Daily Teams
pages.description: Retrieve the daily ranking of top CrowdChange fundraising teams by amount raised over the last 24 hours, for leaderboards and homepage widgets.

pages.title: Top Daily Pages
pages.description: Retrieve the daily ranking of top CrowdChange personal fundraising pages by amount raised over the last 24 hours, for leaderboards and widgets.
